items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...What's his name? James Boynes. ... Do you know Walter Hall? Yeah. [INTERVIEWER] Walter Hall. Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. You got a brother too? Is he still living? Yeah, he's living. He's in New Orleans. Oh, in New Orleans. What's his name? He played piano, funky butts. We call him the funky butts. What's his name? James Boynes. We call him Tom. Oh, yeah. Everybody know him in Tomy Boynes.
